mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_question ( user_id, category_id, question_title, question_content, my_answer, reference_answer, review_summary, difficulty_level, master_level, source_company, source_post, is_collected, is_wrong, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{questionTitle}, #{questionContent}, #{myAnswer}, #{referenceAnswer}, #{reviewSummary}, #{difficultyLevel}, #{masterLevel}, #{sourceCompany}, #{sourcePost}, #{isCollected}, #{isWrong}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_question SET category_id = #{categoryId}, question_title = #{questionTitle}, question_content = #{questionContent}, my_answer = #{myAnswer}, reference_answer = #{referenceAnswer}, review_summary = #{reviewSummary}, difficulty_level = #{difficultyLevel}, master_level = #{masterLevel}, source_company = #{sourceCompany}, source_post = #{sourcePost}, is_collected = #{isCollected}, is_wrong = #{isWrong}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM interview_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM interview_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
